The command prints the capture ID and the file. It prints each budget warning as a Warning: line.

To list the experiment captures and the mirror budget, use the following command. The list has a row for each capture, and a row for each host and bridge under it.

phenix experiment capture list <experiment-name>

To stop an experiment capture, use the following command. It prints the last counters of the capture. The file stays in the experiment's files directory.

phenix experiment capture stop <experiment-name> <capture-ID>

The CLI applies the ui.captures.max-size setting, as phenix ui does, and asks minimega for its version before a capture command. See phenix experiment for all flags.

docs.title: API
docs.text:
Method Path Result GET /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/captures The VM interface captures, the experiment captures (experimentCaptures), the support status (support), and the mirror budget (budget) POST /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/captures Starts a capture. The body has the fields that Capture Options gives. GET /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/captures/{id} One capture, with a row for each host and bridge DELETE /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/captures/{id} Stops a capture and gives its last counters GET /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/captures/{id}/stream Streams a running capture. Add ?from=now to skip the frames before the request. POST /api/v1/experiments/{exp}/webshark Opens WebShark on a capture, with the body {"capture": "<id>"}

A start answers 201 with the capture and its warnings. It answers 409 when the experiment does not run, when the mirror budget refuses the start, or when a running capture or a file has the file name. It answers 501 when minimega does not support experiment captures. The /ws websocket sends an experiment/capture resource named <exp>/<id> with the action start or stop.

The stream sends the capture as a websocket or as a chunked body. A pcapng stream starts with the section header and the interface blocks, also with from=now. For example, show a running capture in Wireshark:

curl -N -H "X-Phenix-Auth-Token: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/experiments/exp1/captures/3/stream" | wireshark -k -i -

See API for the full route reference.

docs.title: Open vSwitch Mirror Budget
docs.text:
Open vSwitch applies a maximum of 32 mirrors on one bridge. It accepts a 33rd mirror without an error, but it ignores it. Each running experiment capture uses one mirror on each host and bridge where the experiment's VMs have an interface on a captured VLAN. Tap mirrors, bridge captures, other experiments on a shared bridge, and mirrors made outside minimega use the same 32 mirrors.

phēnix counts the mirrors of each host and bridge that the experiment uses. It gives each host and bridge a level:

Level Condition What phēnix does ok None of the conditions below Nothing half The experiment uses more than 16 mirrors The Captures tab shows a warning near The bridge has 28 or more mirrors The Captures tab shows a warning full The bridge has 32 mirrors The Captures tab shows an error. For all VLANs, the dialog disables Start capture

phēnix refuses a start, and sends nothing to minimega, in these conditions:

  • A host and bridge that the capture needs has 32 mirrors. The message is, for example, compute1 / mega_bridge_exp1 has 32 of 32 Open vSwitch mirrors.
  • The experiment already runs 32 experiment captures.

After a start, phēnix warns when the capture makes a host and bridge pass a limit:

  • exp1 uses 18 of 32 mirrors on compute1 / mega_bridge_exp1: The experiment uses more than 16 mirrors.
  • compute1 / mega_bridge_exp1 has 29 of 32 mirrors; 3 are left (18 by exp1, 11 by others): The bridge has 28 or more mirrors.

If phēnix cannot count the mirrors, it starts the capture and gives the warning cannot count Open vSwitch mirrors: <error>.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text:
The RBAC resource is experiments/captures. See User Administration.

Verb Permits list The Captures tab and the capture list create A start get One capture. With experiments/files get, also the stream and WebShark. delete A stop

Of the built-in roles, only global-admin has create and delete. One file holds all of the experiment's traffic. Give these verbs only to users who can read all of that traffic. phēnix writes an audit event for each start, stop, and stream. See Logging.

docs.title: Limits
docs.text:
• The capture does not record frames from hardware behind a trunk, or behind a bond to a physical NIC.
  • A packet that a router VM routes shows one time for each VLAN that it crosses.
  • A frame can be larger than the MTU, because of generic segmentation offload (GSO). Other minimega captures do the same.
  • In pcapng, minimega finds the VM port of a frame from the source MAC address. A VM that bridges frames, or that sends with another MAC address, gets the wrong port or no port.
  • An experiment can run a maximum of 32 experiment captures at the same time.
  • The head node receives all captured traffic. If hosts drop frames, the Drops and Lost columns show the numbers. Use the VLANs, the filter, and the snaplen to capture less traffic.
  • When the experiment stops, minimega stops all of its captures. The files stay.
  • When phēnix restarts, the live WebShark views stop. The captures continue in minimega, and phēnix finds them again.

docs.title: The Capture Controls Are Disabled
docs.text:
The controls show the reason. The Captures tab shows it too.

Reason Fix the server did not report capture support Reload the page. If the controls stay disabled, make sure that phenix ui runs. requires minimega 3.4.0 or later; the head node runs <version> Upgrade minimega to 3.4.0 or later on all nodes. Then restart phenix ui. requires minimega 3.4.0 or later; minimega did not answer Make sure that minimega runs on the head node. phenix ui asks for the version again every 10 seconds. requires minimega 3.4.0 or later; cannot read the minimega version "<answer>" Use a minimega build that gives a version, such as minimega 3.4.0. Then restart phenix ui.

phenix doctor shows the capture support in its minimega-captures row.

The ui.features setting does not turn on the capture support. Only the minimega version of the head node turns it on.

docs.title: The Start Is Refused
docs.text:
• <host> / <bridge> has 32 of 32 Open vSwitch mirrors: Stop an experiment capture or a tap mirror on that host. phenix experiment capture list shows the mirror count of each host and bridge.
  • already runs 32 experiment captures: Stop an experiment capture of the experiment.
  • the capture file is in use: A running capture writes the file, or the file exists. Give another file name.
  • experiment is not running: Start the experiment first.
  • An error from minimega about the version of a mesh node: Upgrade minimega on that node.

docs.title: A Skew Warning Shows
docs.text: The clock of a host is more than 500 ms from the clock of the head node. The file has frames of that host out of order. Synchronize the clocks of all hosts with chrony or PTP.

docs.title: See Also
docs.text:
• WebShark: view a capture in the browser, or stream it to Wireshark.
  • phenix vm capture: capture on one VM interface.
  • Experiment Files: download or delete the capture files.

docs.title: Configuration File Schemas
docs.text:
The following schemas are all represented using the OpenAPIv3 format. There is one schema file for each config apiVersion, and it holds the schemas of the kinds stored at that version. phēnix validates each config against the file of its own apiVersion:

apiVersion Schema file Kinds phenix.sandia.gov/v0 v0.yaml Workflow phenix.sandia.gov/v1 v1.yaml Topology, Experiment, Image, User, Role phenix.sandia.gov/v2 v2.yaml Scenario

A config whose kind is not in the file of its apiVersion, such as a phenix.sandia.gov/v2 Topology, is rejected. A running phēnix server serves each file at GET /api/v1/schemas/{version}, and the schema of one kind at GET /api/v1/schemas/{kind}/{version}. The complete files are shown below.

docs.title: Topology Schema
docs.text:
The topology schema is largely comprised of nodes, described here. A topology needs nodes, the includeTopologies key described in Configuration Files, or both.

Topology:
  title: "Topology"
  description: "Schema describing the Topology resource."
  type: object
  anyOf:
  - required:
    - nodes
  - required:
    - includeTopologies
  properties:
    includeTopologies:
      title: "Included Topologies"
      description: >-
        Topology configs or file paths to merge into this topology. A
        single value is the same as a list of one value.
      nullable: true
      anyOf:
      - type: array
        items:
          type: string
      - type: string
      example:
      - /phenix/topologies/common.yml
      - shared-topology
    nodes:
      title: "Nodes"
      description: "Nodes that make up the topology."
      type: array
      items:
        oneOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/minimega_node'
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/external_node'

docs.title: Scenario Schema
docs.text:
Scenario:
  title: "Scenario"
  description: "Schema describing the Scenario resource."
  type: object
  nullable: true
  required:
  - apps
  properties:
    apps:
      title: "Apps"
      description: "Applications configured for this scenario."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: object
        required:
        - name
        properties:
          name:
            title: "Name"
            description: "Name used to identify this resource or entry."
            type: string
            example: example-app
          assetDir:
            title: "Asset Directory"
            description: "Directory containing assets made available to the application."
            type: string
            example: /phenix/topologies/example-topo/assets
          metadata:
            title: "Metadata"
            description: "Application-specific settings shared across its hosts."
            type: object
            nullable: true
            additionalProperties: true
            example:
              setting0: true
              setting1: 42
              setting2: universe key
          runPeriodically:
            title: "Run Periodically"
            description: "Interval at which the application running stage repeats."
            type: string
            example: 30s
          disabled:
            title: "Disabled"
            description: "Whether to skip this application."
            type: boolean
            default: false
            example: false
            nullable: true
          fromScenario:
            title: "From Scenario"
            description: "Scenario inherited by this application configuration."
            type: string
            example: base-scenario
          hosts:
            title: "Hosts"
            description: "Host-specific application settings."
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              required:
              - hostname
              properties:
                hostname:
                  title: "Hostname"
                  description: "Hostname used to identify the node."
                  type: string
                  example: example-host
                metadata:
                  title: "Metadata"
                  description: "Application-specific settings for this host."
                  type: object
                  nullable: true
                  additionalProperties: true
                  example:
                    setting0: true
                    setting1: 42
                    setting2: universe key

docs.title: Experiment Schema
docs.text:
The scenario an experiment embeds uses the experiment_scenario schema in v1.yaml, a copy of the Scenario schema.

Experiment:
  title: "Experiment"
  description: "Schema describing the Experiment resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - topology
  properties:
    topology:
      title: "Topology"
      description: "Topology configuration embedded in or referenced by this resource."
      allOf:
      - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Topology"
    scenario:
      $ref: "#/components/schemas/experiment_scenario"
    baseDir:
      title: "Base Dir"
      description: "Working directory used by the experiment."
      type: string
      example: /phenix/topologies/example-topo
    experimentName:
      title: "Experiment Name"
      description: "Name of the experiment."
      type: string
      example: example-exp
      readOnly: true
    vlans:
      title: "VLANs"
      description: "VLAN IDs and aliases allocated to the experiment."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      properties:
        aliases:
          title: "Aliases"
          description: "Mapping from VLAN aliases to VLAN IDs."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties:
            type: integer
          example:
            MGMT: 200
        min:
          title: "Min"
          description: "Lowest VLAN ID available to the experiment."
          example: 1
          type: integer
        max:
          title: "Max"
          description: "Highest VLAN ID available to the experiment."
          example: 1
          type: integer
    schedules:
      title: "Schedules"
      description: "Mapping from VM hostnames to cluster hosts."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        ADServer: compute1
    defaultBridge:
      title: "Default Bridge"
      description: "Bridge used for experiment VM interfaces by default."
      type: string
      nullable: true
      maxLength: 15
      example: phenix
    deployMode:
      title: "Deploy Mode"
      description: "Cluster hosts eligible to run experiment VMs."
      type: string
      nullable: true
      enum:
      - all
      - no-headnode
      - only-headnode
      example: all
    useGREMesh:
      title: "Use GRE Mesh"
      description: "Whether cluster hosts use a GRE mesh for this experiment."
      type: boolean
      nullable: true
      example: false

docs.title: Image Schema
docs.text:
Image:
  title: "Image"
  description: "Schema describing the Image resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - format
  - mirror
  - release
  - size
  - variant
  properties:
    compress:
      title: "Compress"
      description: "Whether to compress the disk image after creating it."
      type: boolean
      default: false
      example: false
    components:
      title: "Components"
      description: "Distribution components from which to install packages."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - main
      - restricted
    kernel:
      title: "Kernel"
      description: "Kernel command-line arguments included in the image."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - net.ifnames=0
    no_virtuals:
      title: "No Virtuals"
      description: "Whether to omit virtual packages when resolving packages."
      type: boolean
      default: false
      example: false
    format:
      title: "Format"
      description: "Format of the output disk image."
      type: string
      enum:
      - raw
      - qcow2
      - vmdk
      - vdi
      - vhdx
      example: qcow2
    mirror:
      title: "Mirror"
      description: "URL of the distribution mirror used to build the image."
      type: string
      example: http://us.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/
    overlays:
      title: "Overlays"
      description: "Overlay directories applied while building the image."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - /phenix/vmdb/overlays/example-overlay
    packages:
      title: "Packages"
      description: "Additional packages installed in the image."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - isc-dhcp-client
      - openssh-server
    ramdisk:
      title: "Ramdisk"
      description: "Whether to build a kernel and initrd alongside the disk image."
      type: boolean
      default: false
      example: false
    release:
      title: "Release"
      description: "Distribution release used to build the image."
      type: string
      example: focal
    script_order:
      title: "Script Order"
      description: "Script names in the order they run during the image build."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - POSTBUILD_APT_CLEANUP
    scripts:
      title: "Scripts"
      description: "Named scripts available to the image build."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        POSTBUILD_APT_CLEANUP: |
          apt clean || apt-get clean || echo "unable to clean apt cache"
    skip_default_packages:
      title: "Skip Default Packages"
      description: "Whether to omit the default packages of the image builder."
      type: boolean
      default: false
      example: false
    size:
      title: "Size"
      description: "Target size of the generated disk image: a positive number and M or G, such as 10G."
      type: string
      pattern: '^(0*[1-9][0-9]*(\.[0-9]+)?|0+\.[0-9]*[1-9][0-9]*)[MG]$'
      example: 10G
    variant:
      title: "Variant"
      description: "Distribution variant used to build the image."
      type: string
      example: minbase

docs.title: User Schema
docs.text:
User:
  title: "User"
  description: "Schema describing the User resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - first_name
  - last_name
  - username
  properties:
    first_name:
      title: "First Name"
      description: "Given name of the user."
      type: string
      example: John
    last_name:
      title: "Last Name"
      description: "Family name of the user."
      type: string
      example: Doe
    password:
      title: "Password"
      description: "Password supplied for account creation or sign-in."
      type: string
      example: '<encrypted password>'
      readOnly: true
    rbac:
      title: "RBAC"
      description: "Role-based access control settings assigned to this user."
      allOf:
      - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Role"
      readOnly: true
    username:
      title: "Username"
      description: "Username used to identify the account."
      type: string
      example: johndoe@example.com

docs.title: Role Schema
docs.text:
Role:
  title: "Role"
  description: "Schema describing the Role resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - policies
  - roleName
  properties:
    policies:
      title: "Policies"
      description: "Access policies assigned to this role."
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
        properties:
          resources:
            title: "Resources"
            description: "Resource types covered by this policy."
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          resourceNames:
            title: "Resource Names"
            description: "Resource names covered by this policy."
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          verbs:
            title: "Verbs"
            description: "Actions allowed on the listed resources."
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      example:
      - resources:
        - experiments
        - experiments/*
        resourceNames:
        - '*'
        verbs:
        - list
        - get
    roleName:
      title: "Role Name"
      description: "Name assigned to this role."
      type: string
      example: Example Role

docs.title: Workflow Schema
docs.text: The workflow config (phenix.yml) is validated against the Workflow schema in schema version v0. It is documented, with every field, in Workflow.

docs.title: minimega_node Schema
docs.text:
The minimega_node schema contains references to the interface schema described here.

minimega_node:
  title: "Minimega Node"
  description: "Schema describing the Minimega Node resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - type
  - general
  - hardware
  properties:
    type:
      title: "Type"
      description: >-
        What the node is. phenix configures Router and Firewall nodes whose OS type is vyatta, vyos or minirouter as
        routers, from their interfaces, routes, OSPF settings and rulesets.
      type: string
      enum:
      - VirtualMachine
      - Firewall
      - Router
      - Switch
      default: VirtualMachine
      example: VirtualMachine
    annotations:
      title: "Annotations"
      description: "Free-form annotations associated with this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties: true
      example:
        app: web
    labels:
      title: "Labels"
      description: "String labels used to select or group nodes."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        tier: frontend
    general:
      title: "General"
      description: "General node settings."
      type: object
      required:
      - hostname
      properties:
        hostname:
          title: "Hostname"
          description: >-
            Name of the VM in minimega and the host name set in the guest.
            The name is unique in the topology.
          # 2 to 63 letters, digits, and interior hyphens. Guest operating
          # systems phenix configures reject 1-character hostnames.
          #
          # VyOS and Vyatta validate `system host-name` against
          # `[A-Za-z0-9][-.A-Za-z0-9]*[A-Za-z0-9]`, which needs at least 2
          # characters:
          # https://docs.vyos.io/en/latest/configuration/system/host-name.html
          # https://github.com/vyos/vyos-1x/blob/ed218c254d964775ddf24158ac6520972d575faf/interface-definitions/include/constraint/host-name.xml.i
          #
          # Windows DNS host names have a 2-character minimum:
          # https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/active-directory/naming-conventions-for-computer-domain-site-ou#dns-host-names
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 63
          pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
          example: ADServer
        description:
          title: "Description"
          description: 'Free-text notes about the node.'
          type: string
          example: Active Directory Server
        vm_type:
          title: "VM Type"
          description: >-
            How minimega runs the node: kvm for a QEMU/KVM virtual machine, or container. Empty means kvm.
          type: string
          enum:
          - kvm
          - container
          - ""
          default: kvm
          example: kvm
        snapshot:
          title: "Snapshot"
          description: >-
            Run the VM on a copy-on-write snapshot of its first drive, which phenix creates for the experiment and
            injects files into, so the image file itself does not change. phenix turns this on when it is not set.
          type: boolean
          default: true
          example: true
          nullable: true
        do_not_boot:
          title: "Do Not Boot"
          description: >-
            Leave the node out when the experiment starts: phenix neither creates nor starts its VM. phenix also
            sets this when the first drive's image is missing.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
          nullable: true
    hardware:
      title: "Hardware"
      description: "Virtual hardware assigned to the node."
      type: object
      required:
      - os_type
      - drives
      properties:
        cpu:
          title: "CPU"
          description: 'QEMU CPU model for the VM, such as Broadwell or host.'
          type: string
          default: Broadwell
          example: Broadwell
        vcpus:
          title: "Virtual CPUs"
          description: 'Number of virtual CPUs. phenix uses 1 when it is not set.'
          oneOf:
          - type: integer
          - type: string
          default: 1
          example: 4
        memory:
          title: "Memory"
          description: 'Memory for the VM, in megabytes. phenix uses 512 when it is not set.'
          oneOf:
          - type: integer
          - type: string
          default: 512
          example: 8192
        os_type:
          title: "OS Type"
          description: >-
            Operating system in the disk image. phenix and its apps choose startup scripts and router configuration
            by it.
          type: string
          enum:
          - centos
          - linux
          - minirouter
          - rhel
          - vyatta
          - vyos
          - windows
          - other
          default: linux
          example: windows
        drives:
          title: "Drives"
          description: >-
            Disks attached to the VM, in order. The first is the one phenix snapshots and injects files into.
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - image
            properties:
              image:
                title: "Image"
                description: >-
                  Disk image file: a name in the phenix image directory, or an absolute path on the host.
                type: string
                minLength: 1
                example: ubuntu.qc2
              interface:
                title: "Interface"
                description: >-
                  Bus the disk is attached to, such as ide, scsi or virtio. Empty uses minimega's default.
                type: string
                enum:
                - ahci
                - ide
                - scsi
                - sd
                - mtd
                - floppy
                - pflash
                - virtio
                - ""
                default: ide
                example: ide
              cache_mode:
                title: "Cache Mode"
                description: >-
                  QEMU cache mode for the disk. Empty uses writeback for a snapshot, and QEMU's default otherwise.
                type: string
                enum:
                - none
                - writeback
                - unsafe
                - directsync
                - writethrough
                - ""
                default: writeback
                example: writeback
              inject_partition:
                title: "Inject Partition"
                description: >-
                  Partition of the first drive that phenix injects files into. 0 skips disk injection, and phenix
                  sends its startup scripts through minimega command and control instead. phenix uses 1 when it is
                  not set.
                type: integer
                default: 1
                example: 2
                nullable: true
    network:
      title: "Network"
      description: "Network settings associated with this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      required:
      - interfaces
      properties:
        interfaces:
          title: "Interfaces"
          description: 'Network interfaces, in the order the guest sees them.'
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/static_iface'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/dhcp_iface'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/serial_iface'
        routes:
          title: "Routes"
          description: 'Static routes phenix configures in the guest.'
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - destination
            - next
            properties:
              destination:
                title: "Destination"
                description: 'Network to reach, in CIDR notation such as 192.168.0.0/24.'
                type: string
                example: 192.168.0.0/24
              next:
                title: "Next"
                description: 'Address of the next hop toward the destination.'
                type: string
                example: 192.168.1.254
              cost:
                title: "Cost"
                description: 'Route cost, set as the administrative distance on Vyatta and VyOS routers.'
                type: integer
                default: 1
                example: 1
                nullable: true
        ospf:
          title: "OSPF"
          description: "Open Shortest Path First routing settings."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          required:
          - router_id
          - areas
          properties:
            router_id:
              title: "Router Id"
              description: 'OSPF router ID, written like an IPv4 address, such as 0.0.0.1.'
              type: string
              example: 0.0.0.1
            areas:
              title: "Areas"
              description: 'OSPF areas the router takes part in.'
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                required:
                - area_id
                - area_networks
                properties:
                  area_id:
                    title: "Area Id"
                    description: 'OSPF area number. 0 is the backbone area.'
                    type: integer
                    example: 1
                    default: 1
                  area_networks:
                    title: "Area Networks"
                    description: 'Networks the router advertises in the area.'
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      required:
                      - network
                      properties:
                        network:
                          title: "Network"
                          description: 'Network in CIDR notation, such as 10.1.25.0/24.'
                          type: string
                          example: 10.1.25.0/24
            dead_interval:
              title: "Dead Interval"
              description: >-
                Seconds without a hello from a neighbor before the router considers it down. Applies to interfaces
                whose protocol is ospf.
              type: integer
              nullable: true
              example: 40
            hello_interval:
              title: "Hello Interval"
              description: 'Seconds between OSPF hello packets. Applies to interfaces whose protocol is ospf.'
              type: integer
              nullable: true
              example: 10
            retransmission_interval:
              title: "Retransmission Interval"
              description: >-
                Seconds before the router resends a link-state advertisement that was not acknowledged. Applies to
                interfaces whose protocol is ospf.
              type: integer
              nullable: true
              example: 5
        rulesets:
          title: "Rulesets"
          description: >-
            Firewall rulesets for Router and Firewall nodes. An interface applies one by naming it as its inbound or
            outbound ruleset.
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - name
            - default
            - rules
            properties:
              name:
                title: "Name"
                description: 'Name interfaces use to apply the ruleset.'
                type: string
                example: OutToDMZ
              description:
                title: "Description"
                description: 'Describes the ruleset in the router configuration.'
                type: string
                example: From Corp to the DMZ network
              default:
                title: "Default"
                description: 'What happens to traffic that no rule matches.'
                type: string
                enum:
                - accept
                - drop
                - reject
                example: drop
              rules:
                title: "Rules"
                description: 'Rules of the ruleset.'
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  required:
                  - id
                  - action
                  - protocol
                  properties:
                    id:
                      title: "Id"
                      description: >-
                        Rule number, unique in the ruleset. Vyatta and VyOS routers check rules from the lowest
                        number up.
                      type: integer
                      example: 10
                    description:
                      title: "Description"
                      description: 'Describes the rule in the router configuration.'
                      type: string
                      example: Allow UDP 10.1.26.80 ==> 10.2.25.0/24:123
                    action:
                      title: "Action"
                      description: 'What happens to traffic the rule matches.'
                      type: string
                      enum:
                      - accept
                      - drop
                      - reject
                      example: accept
                    protocol:
                      title: "Protocol"
                      description: 'Protocol of the traffic the rule matches.'
                      type: string
                      enum:
                      - tcp
                      - udp
                      - tcp_udp
                      - icmp
                      - esp
                      - ah
                      - all
                      default: tcp
                      example: tcp
                    source:
                      title: "Source"
                      description: "Source address and optional port matched by this rule."
                      type: object
                      nullable: true
                      required:
                      - address
                      properties:
                        address:
                          title: "Address"
                          description: 'Source address or network the rule matches.'
                          type: string
                          example: 10.1.24.60
                        port:
                          title: "Port"
                          description: 'Source port the rule matches. Empty or 0 matches any port.'
                          type: integer
                          example: 3389
                    destination:
                      title: "Destination"
                      description: "Destination network or address for this route or rule."
                      type: object
                      nullable: true
                      required:
                      - address
                      properties:
                        address:
                          title: "Address"
                          description: 'Destination address or network the rule matches.'
                          type: string
                          example: 10.1.24.60
                        port:
                          title: "Port"
                          description: 'Destination port the rule matches. Empty or 0 matches any port.'
                          type: integer
                          example: 3389
                    stateful:
                      title: "Stateful"
                      description: "Whether the firewall rule tracks connection state."
                      type: boolean
                      example: true
        nat:
          title: "Nat"
          description: "Mappings for network address translation on this node."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              in:
                title: "In"
                description: "Names of the internal interfaces whose networks this NAT rule maps."
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
                example:
                - eth1
              out:
                title: "Out"
                description: "External interface used by this NAT rule."
                type: string
                example: eth0
    injections:
      title: "Injections"
      description: 'Files phenix copies into the snapshot of the first drive before the VM starts.'
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: object
        required:
        - src
        - dst
        properties:
          src:
            title: "Source"
            description: >-
              File on the phenix host: an absolute path, or a path relative to the experiment directory.
            type: string
            example: foo.xml
          dst:
            title: "Destination"
            description: 'Path the file is written to in the guest.'
            type: string
            example: /etc/phenix/foo.xml
          description:
            title: "Description"
            description: 'Free-text notes about the file.'
            type: string
            example: phenix config file
          permissions:
            title: "Permissions"
            description: 'File mode for the copied file, in octal such as 0664.'
            type: string
            example: '0664'
    deletions:
      title: "Deletions"
      description: "Files to remove from the node disk before boot."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: object
        required:
        - path
        properties:
          path:
            title: "Path"
            description: "Path to remove from the node disk."
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            example: /etc/obsolete.conf
          description:
            title: "Description"
            description: "Human-readable description of this resource or entry."
            type: string
            example: Remove the obsolete configuration file
    overrides:
      title: "Overrides"
      description: "Minimega VM settings overridden for this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        memory: "4096"
    delay:
      title: "Delay"
      description: "Conditions that delay the node start."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      properties:
        timer:
          title: "Timer"
          description: 'Start the VM this long after the experiment starts, as a duration such as 30s or 5m.'
          type: string
          pattern: '^$|^[-+]?(0|(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(ns|us|µs|μs|ms|s|m|h))+)$'
          example: 5m
        user:
          title: "User"
          description: >-
            Leave the VM stopped until someone starts it from phenix or minimega. Takes precedence over the other
            delays.
          example: false
          type: boolean
        c2:
          title: "C2"
          description: 'Start the VM once each of these hosts has checked in with minimega command and control.'
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              hostname:
                title: "Hostname"
                description: 'Host to wait for.'
                example: node-01
                type: string
              useUUID:
                title: "Use UUID"
                description: 'Wait for the host''s UUID, rather than its hostname, to check in.'
                example: false
                type: boolean
    advanced:
      title: "Advanced"
      description: 'Extra minimega vm config settings, each a setting name and its value.'
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        rtc.utc: "true"
    commands:
      title: "Commands"
      description: 'minimega command and control (cc) commands phenix sends to the VM, such as exec df -h.'
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - exec df -h

docs.title: external_node Schema
docs.text:
external_node:
  title: "External Node"
  description: "Schema describing the External Node resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - external
  - type
  - general
  properties:
    external:
      title: "External"
      description: >-
        Marks a device phenix does not deploy, such as hardware in the loop. It stays in the topology for State of
        Health and apps.
      example: true
      type: boolean
      enum:
      - true
    annotations:
      title: "Annotations"
      description: "Free-form annotations associated with this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties: true
      example:
        physical: true
    labels:
      title: "Labels"
      description: "String labels used to select or group nodes."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
      example:
        tier: endpoint
    type:
      title: "Type"
      description: 'What the device is, such as HIL for hardware in the loop.'
      type: string
      default: HIL
      example: HIL
    general:
      title: "General"
      description: "General node settings."
      type: object
      required:
      - hostname
      properties:
        hostname:
          title: "Hostname"
          description: 'Name of the device in the topology.'
          type: string
          example: ADServer
        description:
          title: "Description"
          description: 'Free-text notes about the device.'
          type: string
          example: Active Directory Server
        vm_type:
          title: "VM Type"
          description: 'Whether the device is a virtual machine or a container.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - vm
          - container
          - ""
          default: vm
          example: vm
    hardware:
      title: "Hardware"
      description: "Virtual hardware assigned to the node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      required:
      - os_type
      properties:
        cpu:
          title: "CPU"
          description: 'CPU model of the device.'
          type: string
          default: Broadwell
          example: Broadwell
        vcpus:
          title: "Virtual CPUs"
          description: 'Number of CPUs of the device.'
          oneOf:
          - type: integer
          - type: string
          default: 1
          example: 4
        memory:
          title: "Memory"
          description: 'Memory of the device, in megabytes.'
          oneOf:
          - type: integer
          - type: string
          default: 512
          example: 8192
        os_type:
          title: "OS Type"
          description: 'Operating system of the device.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - centos
          - linux
          - minirouter
          - rhel
          - vyatta
          - vyos
          - windows
          - other
          default: linux
          example: windows
    network:
      title: "Network"
      description: "Network settings associated with this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      required:
      - interfaces
      properties:
        interfaces:
          title: "Interfaces"
          description: >-
            Network interfaces of the device, for the topology's network diagram and State of Health checks.
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - name
            properties:
              name:
                title: "Name"
                description: 'Interface name, such as eth0.'
                type: string
                example: eth0
              proto:
                title: "Protocol"
                description: 'How the interface gets its address: static, dhcp, or manual for none.'
                type: string
                enum:
                - static
                - dhcp
                - manual
                - ""
                default: dhcp
                example: static
              address:
                title: "Address"
                description: 'IPv4 address of the interface.'
                type: string
                format: ipv4
                example: 192.168.1.100
              mask:
                title: "Mask"
                description: 'Network prefix length (CIDR bits), from 0 to 32.'
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
                maximum: 32
                default: 24
                example: 24
              gateway:
                title: "Gateway"
                description: 'Default gateway of the interface.'
                type: string
                format: ipv4
                example: 192.168.1.1
              vlan:
                title: "VLAN"
                description: 'VLAN (network) the interface is on.'
                type: string
                example: EXP-1
    injections:
      title: "Injections"
      description: "Files to copy into the node disk before boot."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: object
        required:
        - src
        - dst
        properties:
          src:
            title: "Source"
            description: "Source file copied into the node disk."
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            example: ./config.txt
          dst:
            title: "Destination"
            description: "Destination path for the injected file."
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            example: /etc/config.txt
          description:
            title: "Description"
            description: "Human-readable description of this resource or entry."
            type: string
            example: Inject endpoint config
          permissions:
            title: "Permissions"
            description: "File permissions to set on the injected file."
            type: string
            example: '0644'
    deletions:
      title: "Deletions"
      description: "Files to remove from the node disk before boot."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: object
        required:
        - path
        properties:
          path:
            title: "Path"
            description: "Path to remove from the node disk."
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            example: /tmp/obsolete
          description:
            title: "Description"
            description: "Human-readable description of this resource or entry."
            type: string
            example: Remove obsolete endpoint file
    overrides:
      title: "Overrides"
      description: "Minimega VM settings overridden for this node."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
    delay:
      title: "Delay"
      description: "Conditions that delay the node start."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      properties:
        timer:
          title: "Timer"
          description: "Duration to wait before starting the node, in Go duration syntax such as 5m or 1h30m."
          type: string
          pattern: '^$|^[-+]?(0|(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(ns|us|µs|μs|ms|s|m|h))+)$'
          example: 5m
        user:
          title: "User"
          description: "Whether node start requires user confirmation."
          type: boolean
          example: true
        c2:
          title: "C2"
          description: "Command-and-control hosts whose availability can release the delay."
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              hostname:
                title: "Hostname"
                description: "Hostname used to identify the node."
                type: string
                example: c2-server
              useUUID:
                title: "Use UUID"
                description: "Whether to match the command-and-control host by UUID."
                type: boolean
                example: false
    advanced:
      title: "Advanced"
      description: "Additional minimega VM settings."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      additionalProperties:
        type: string
    commands:
      title: "Commands"
      description: "Minimega commands to run for this node."
      type: array
      nullable: true
      items:
        type: string
      example:
      - exec hostname

docs.title: Interface Schema
docs.text:
iface:
  title: "Interface"
  description: "Schema describing the Iface resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - name
  - vlan
  properties:
    name:
      title: "Name"
      description: 'Interface name, such as eth0, which NAT settings and apps use to refer to it.'
      type: string
      example: eth0
    vlan:
      title: "VLAN"
      description: 'VLAN (network) the interface is on.'
      type: string
      example: EXP-1
    autostart:
      title: "Autostart"
      description: >-
        Whether the interface should come up when the VM boots. phenix itself does not act on this setting.
      example: true
      type: boolean
      default: true
    mac:
      title: "MAC"
      description: 'MAC address. minimega generates one when it is empty.'
      type: string
      example: 00:11:22:33:44:55
      pattern: '^$|^([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:-]){5}([0-9a-fA-F]){2}$'
    mtu:
      title: "MTU"
      description: >-
        Maximum transmission unit, in bytes. Vyatta and VyOS routers apply values from 68 to 16000; other images
        keep their own.
      type: integer
      default: 1500
      example: 1500
    bridge:
      title: "Bridge"
      description: >-
        Open vSwitch bridge on the host the interface attaches to. Empty or phenix uses the experiment's default
        bridge.
      example: phenix
      type: string
      default: phenix
    driver:
      title: "Driver"
      description: 'Emulated network card, such as e1000 or virtio-net-pci. Empty uses minimega''s default.'
      type: string
      example: e1000
    qinq:
      title: "QinQ"
      description: >-
        Carry the guest's own VLAN tags inside the interface's VLAN (QinQ, 802.1ad). The guest brings the interface
        up without an address.
      example: false
      type: boolean
      default: false
iface_address:
  title: "Interface Address"
  description: "Schema describing the Iface Address resource."
  type: object
  required:
  - address
  - mask
  properties:
    address:
      title: "Address"
      description: 'IPv4 address of the interface.'
      type: string
      format: ipv4
      example: 192.168.1.100
    mask:
      title: "Mask"
      description: 'Network prefix length (CIDR bits), from 0 to 32.'
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 32
      default: 24
      example: 24
    gateway:
      title: "Gateway"
      description: 'Default gateway, reached through this interface.'
      type: string
      format: ipv4
      example: 192.168.1.1
    dns:
      title: "DNS Servers"
      description: 'DNS server addresses the guest uses: one address, or a list.'
      nullable: true
      oneOf:
      - type: string
      - type: array
        items:
          type: string
      example:
      - 192.168.1.1
      - 192.168.1.2
iface_rulesets:
  title: "Interface Rulesets"
  description: "Schema describing the Iface Rulesets resource."
  type: object
  properties:
    ruleset_out:
      title: "Ruleset Out"
      description: 'Ruleset for traffic going out of this interface, on Router and Firewall nodes.'
      type: string
      example: OutToInet
      pattern: '^[\w-]*$'
    ruleset_in:
      title: "Ruleset In"
      description: 'Ruleset for traffic coming in on this interface, on Router and Firewall nodes.'
      type: string
      example: InFromInet
      pattern: '^[\w-]*$'
static_iface:
  title: "Static Interface"
  description: "Schema describing the Static Iface resource."
  allOf:
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_address'
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
  required:
  - type
  - proto
  properties:
    type:
      title: "Type"
      description: 'Kind of interface: ethernet.'
      type: string
      enum:
      - ethernet
      default: ethernet
      example: ethernet
    proto:
      title: "Protocol"
      description: >-
        How the interface is addressed: static for a fixed address, or ospf for a fixed address that also takes part
        in OSPF on a router.
      type: string
      enum:
      - static
      - ospf
      default: static
      example: static
dhcp_iface:
  title: "DHCP Interface"
  description: "Schema describing the Dhcp Iface resource."
  allOf:
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
  required:
  - type
  - proto
  properties:
    type:
      title: "Type"
      description: 'Kind of interface: ethernet.'
      type: string
      enum:
      - ethernet
      default: ethernet
      example: ethernet
    proto:
      title: "Protocol"
      description: >-
        How the interface is addressed: dhcp to ask a DHCP server, or manual to bring it up with no address.
      type: string
      enum:
      - dhcp
      - manual
      default: dhcp
      example: dhcp
serial_iface:
  title: "Serial Interface"
  description: "Schema describing the Serial Iface resource."
  allOf:
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_address'
  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
  required:
  - type
  - proto
  - udp_port
  - baud_rate
  - device
  properties:
    type:
      title: "Type"
      description: 'Kind of interface: a serial link, carried over the network between VMs.'
      type: string
      enum:
      - serial
      default: serial
      example: serial
    proto:
      title: "Protocol"
      description: 'Serial interfaces have a static address.'
      type: string
      enum:
      - static
      default: static
      example: static
    udp_port:
      title: "UDP Port"
      description: 'UDP port that carries the serial traffic between VMs.'
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 65535
      default: 8989
      example: 8989
    baud_rate:
      title: "Baud Rate"
      description: 'Speed of the serial line, in bits per second.'
      type: integer
      enum:
      - 110
      - 300
      - 600
      - 1200
      - 2400
      - 4800
      - 9600
      - 14400
      - 19200
      - 38400
      - 57600
      - 115200
      - 128000
      - 256000
      default: 9600
      example: 9600
    device:
      title: "Device"
      description: 'Serial device the guest uses, such as /dev/ttyS0.'
      type: string
      default: /dev/ttyS0
      example: /dev/ttyS0

docs.title: v1.yaml
docs.text:
<pre><code># Schemas for the config kinds stored at apiVersion phenix.sandia.gov/v1:
# Topology, Experiment, Image, User and Role. Configs are validated against
# the schema file of their own apiVersion, so a kind appears only in the
# file of the version it is stored at (see version.StoredVersion).
# The "--8<--" comments mark the sections docs/content/schema.md shows; the
# last section runs to the end of the file.
openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: phenix config specs
  version: "1.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Image:
      title: "Image"
      description: "Schema describing the Image resource."
      type: object
      required:
      - format
      - mirror
      - release
      - size
      - variant
      properties:
        compress:
          title: "Compress"
          description: "Whether to compress the disk image after creating it."
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
        components:
          title: "Components"
          description: "Distribution components from which to install packages."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - main
          - restricted
        kernel:
          title: "Kernel"
          description: "Kernel command-line arguments included in the image."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - net.ifnames=0
        no_virtuals:
          title: "No Virtuals"
          description: "Whether to omit virtual packages when resolving packages."
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
        format:
          title: "Format"
          description: "Format of the output disk image."
          type: string
          enum:
          - raw
          - qcow2
          - vmdk
          - vdi
          - vhdx
          example: qcow2
        mirror:
          title: "Mirror"
          description: "URL of the distribution mirror used to build the image."
          type: string
          example: http://us.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/
        overlays:
          title: "Overlays"
          description: "Overlay directories applied while building the image."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - /phenix/vmdb/overlays/example-overlay
        packages:
          title: "Packages"
          description: "Additional packages installed in the image."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - isc-dhcp-client
          - openssh-server
        ramdisk:
          title: "Ramdisk"
          description: "Whether to build a kernel and initrd alongside the disk image."
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
        release:
          title: "Release"
          description: "Distribution release used to build the image."
          type: string
          example: focal
        script_order:
          title: "Script Order"
          description: "Script names in the order they run during the image build."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - POSTBUILD_APT_CLEANUP
        scripts:
          title: "Scripts"
          description: "Named scripts available to the image build."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties:
            type: string
          example:
            POSTBUILD_APT_CLEANUP: |
              apt clean || apt-get clean || echo "unable to clean apt cache"
        skip_default_packages:
          title: "Skip Default Packages"
          description: "Whether to omit the default packages of the image builder."
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
        size:
          title: "Size"
          description: "Target size of the generated disk image: a positive number and M or G, such as 10G."
          type: string
          pattern: '^(0*[1-9][0-9]*(\.[0-9]+)?|0+\.[0-9]*[1-9][0-9]*)[MG]$'
          example: 10G
        variant:
          title: "Variant"
          description: "Distribution variant used to build the image."
          type: string
          example: minbase
    Role:
      title: "Role"
      description: "Schema describing the Role resource."
      type: object
      required:
      - policies
      - roleName
      properties:
        policies:
          title: "Policies"
          description: "Access policies assigned to this role."
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              resources:
                title: "Resources"
                description: "Resource types covered by this policy."
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              resourceNames:
                title: "Resource Names"
                description: "Resource names covered by this policy."
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              verbs:
                title: "Verbs"
                description: "Actions allowed on the listed resources."
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
          example:
          - resources:
            - experiments
            - experiments/*
            resourceNames:
            - '*'
            verbs:
            - list
            - get
        roleName:
          title: "Role Name"
          description: "Name assigned to this role."
          type: string
          example: Example Role
    User:
      title: "User"
      description: "Schema describing the User resource."
      type: object
      required:
      - first_name
      - last_name
      - username
      properties:
        first_name:
          title: "First Name"
          description: "Given name of the user."
          type: string
          example: John
        last_name:
          title: "Last Name"
          description: "Family name of the user."
          type: string
          example: Doe
        password:
          title: "Password"
          description: "Password supplied for account creation or sign-in."
          type: string
          example: '<encrypted password>'
          readOnly: true
        rbac:
          title: "RBAC"
          description: "Role-based access control settings assigned to this user."
          allOf:
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Role"
          readOnly: true
        username:
          title: "Username"
          description: "Username used to identify the account."
          type: string
          example: johndoe@example.com
    Topology:
      title: "Topology"
      description: "Schema describing the Topology resource."
      type: object
      anyOf:
      - required:
        - nodes
      - required:
        - includeTopologies
      properties:
        includeTopologies:
          title: "Included Topologies"
          description: >-
            Topology configs or file paths to merge into this topology. A
            single value is the same as a list of one value.
          nullable: true
          anyOf:
          - type: array
            items:
              type: string
          - type: string
          example:
          - /phenix/topologies/common.yml
          - shared-topology
        nodes:
          title: "Nodes"
          description: "Nodes that make up the topology."
          type: array
          items:
            oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/minimega_node'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/external_node'
    Experiment:
      title: "Experiment"
      description: "Schema describing the Experiment resource."
      type: object
      required:
      - topology
      properties:
        topology:
          title: "Topology"
          description: "Topology configuration embedded in or referenced by this resource."
          allOf:
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Topology"
        scenario:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/experiment_scenario"
        baseDir:
          title: "Base Dir"
          description: "Working directory used by the experiment."
          type: string
          example: /phenix/topologies/example-topo
        experimentName:
          title: "Experiment Name"
          description: "Name of the experiment."
          type: string
          example: example-exp
          readOnly: true
        vlans:
          title: "VLANs"
          description: "VLAN IDs and aliases allocated to the experiment."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          properties:
            aliases:
              title: "Aliases"
              description: "Mapping from VLAN aliases to VLAN IDs."
              type: object
              nullable: true
              additionalProperties:
                type: integer
              example:
                MGMT: 200
            min:
              title: "Min"
              description: "Lowest VLAN ID available to the experiment."
              example: 1
              type: integer
            max:
              title: "Max"
              description: "Highest VLAN ID available to the experiment."
              example: 1
              type: integer
        schedules:
          title: "Schedules"
          description: "Mapping from VM hostnames to cluster hosts."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties:
            type: string
          example:
            ADServer: compute1
        defaultBridge:
          title: "Default Bridge"
          description: "Bridge used for experiment VM interfaces by default."
          type: string
          nullable: true
          maxLength: 15
          example: phenix
        deployMode:
          title: "Deploy Mode"
          description: "Cluster hosts eligible to run experiment VMs."
          type: string
          nullable: true
          enum:
          - all
          - no-headnode
          - only-headnode
          example: all
        useGREMesh:
          title: "Use GRE Mesh"
          description: "Whether cluster hosts use a GRE mesh for this experiment."
          type: boolean
          nullable: true
          example: false
    # experiment_scenario is the scenario an Experiment embeds. It is a copy of
    # the Scenario component in v2.yaml, the only version a Scenario config is
    # stored at; TestExperimentScenarioMatchesScenario keeps the two identical.
    experiment_scenario:
      title: "Scenario"
      description: "Schema describing the Scenario resource."
      type: object
      nullable: true
      required:
      - apps
      properties:
        apps:
          title: "Apps"
          description: "Applications configured for this scenario."
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - name
            properties:
              name:
                title: "Name"
                description: "Name used to identify this resource or entry."
                type: string
                example: example-app
              assetDir:
                title: "Asset Directory"
                description: "Directory containing assets made available to the application."
                type: string
                example: /phenix/topologies/example-topo/assets
              metadata:
                title: "Metadata"
                description: "Application-specific settings shared across its hosts."
                type: object
                nullable: true
                additionalProperties: true
                example:
                  setting0: true
                  setting1: 42
                  setting2: universe key
              runPeriodically:
                title: "Run Periodically"
                description: "Interval at which the application running stage repeats."
                type: string
                example: 30s
              disabled:
                title: "Disabled"
                description: "Whether to skip this application."
                type: boolean
                default: false
                example: false
                nullable: true
              fromScenario:
                title: "From Scenario"
                description: "Scenario inherited by this application configuration."
                type: string
                example: base-scenario
              hosts:
                title: "Hosts"
                description: "Host-specific application settings."
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  required:
                  - hostname
                  properties:
                    hostname:
                      title: "Hostname"
                      description: "Hostname used to identify the node."
                      type: string
                      example: example-host
                    metadata:
                      title: "Metadata"
                      description: "Application-specific settings for this host."
                      type: object
                      nullable: true
                      additionalProperties: true
                      example:
                        setting0: true
                        setting1: 42
                        setting2: universe key
    minimega_node:
      title: "Minimega Node"
      description: "Schema describing the Minimega Node resource."
      type: object
      required:
      - type
      - general
      - hardware
      properties:
        type:
          title: "Type"
          description: >-
            What the node is. phenix configures Router and Firewall nodes whose OS type is vyatta, vyos or minirouter as
            routers, from their interfaces, routes, OSPF settings and rulesets.
          type: string
          enum:
          - VirtualMachine
          - Firewall
          - Router
          - Switch
          default: VirtualMachine
          example: VirtualMachine
        annotations:
          title: "Annotations"
          description: "Free-form annotations associated with this node."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties: true
          example:
            app: web
        labels:
          title: "Labels"
          description: "String labels used to select or group nodes."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties:
            type: string
          example:
            tier: frontend
        general:
          title: "General"
          description: "General node settings."
          type: object
          required:
          - hostname
          properties:
            hostname:
              title: "Hostname"
              description: >-
                Name of the VM in minimega and the host name set in the guest.
                The name is unique in the topology.
              # 2 to 63 letters, digits, and interior hyphens. Guest operating
              # systems phenix configures reject 1-character hostnames.
              #
              # VyOS and Vyatta validate `system host-name` against
              # `[A-Za-z0-9][-.A-Za-z0-9]*[A-Za-z0-9]`, which needs at least 2
              # characters:
              # https://docs.vyos.io/en/latest/configuration/system/host-name.html
              # https://github.com/vyos/vyos-1x/blob/ed218c254d964775ddf24158ac6520972d575faf/interface-definitions/include/constraint/host-name.xml.i
              #
              # Windows DNS host names have a 2-character minimum:
              # https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/active-directory/naming-conventions-for-computer-domain-site-ou#dns-host-names
              type: string
              minLength: 2
              maxLength: 63
              pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
              example: ADServer
            description:
              title: "Description"
              description: 'Free-text notes about the node.'
              type: string
              example: Active Directory Server
            vm_type:
              title: "VM Type"
              description: >-
                How minimega runs the node: kvm for a QEMU/KVM virtual machine, or container. Empty means kvm.
              type: string
              enum:
              - kvm
              - container
              - ""
              default: kvm
              example: kvm
            snapshot:
              title: "Snapshot"
              description: >-
                Run the VM on a copy-on-write snapshot of its first drive, which phenix creates for the experiment and
                injects files into, so the image file itself does not change. phenix turns this on when it is not set.
              type: boolean
              default: true
              example: true
              nullable: true
            do_not_boot:
              title: "Do Not Boot"
              description: >-
                Leave the node out when the experiment starts: phenix neither creates nor starts its VM. phenix also
                sets this when the first drive's image is missing.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              nullable: true
        hardware:
          title: "Hardware"
          description: "Virtual hardware assigned to the node."
          type: object
          required:
          - os_type
          - drives
          properties:
            cpu:
              title: "CPU"
              description: 'QEMU CPU model for the VM, such as Broadwell or host.'
              type: string
              default: Broadwell
              example: Broadwell
            vcpus:
              title: "Virtual CPUs"
              description: 'Number of virtual CPUs. phenix uses 1 when it is not set.'
              oneOf:
              - type: integer
              - type: string
              default: 1
              example: 4
            memory:
              title: "Memory"
              description: 'Memory for the VM, in megabytes. phenix uses 512 when it is not set.'
              oneOf:
              - type: integer
              - type: string
              default: 512
              example: 8192
            os_type:
              title: "OS Type"
              description: >-
                Operating system in the disk image. phenix and its apps choose startup scripts and router configuration
                by it.
              type: string
              enum:
              - centos
              - linux
              - minirouter
              - rhel
              - vyatta
              - vyos
              - windows
              - other
              default: linux
              example: windows
            drives:
              title: "Drives"
              description: >-
                Disks attached to the VM, in order. The first is the one phenix snapshots and injects files into.
              type: array
              minItems: 1
              items:
                type: object
                required:
                - image
                properties:
                  image:
                    title: "Image"
                    description: >-
                      Disk image file: a name in the phenix image directory, or an absolute path on the host.
                    type: string
                    minLength: 1
                    example: ubuntu.qc2
                  interface:
                    title: "Interface"
                    description: >-
                      Bus the disk is attached to, such as ide, scsi or virtio. Empty uses minimega's default.
                    type: string
                    enum:
                    - ahci
                    - ide
                    - scsi
                    - sd
                    - mtd
                    - floppy
                    - pflash
                    - virtio
                    - ""
                    default: ide
                    example: ide
                  cache_mode:
                    title: "Cache Mode"
                    description: >-
                      QEMU cache mode for the disk. Empty uses writeback for a snapshot, and QEMU's default otherwise.
                    type: string
                    enum:
                    - none
                    - writeback
                    - unsafe
                    - directsync
                    - writethrough
                    - ""
                    default: writeback
                    example: writeback
                  inject_partition:
                    title: "Inject Partition"
                    description: >-
                      Partition of the first drive that phenix injects files into. 0 skips disk injection, and phenix
                      sends its startup scripts through minimega command and control instead. phenix uses 1 when it is
                      not set.
                    type: integer
                    default: 1
                    example: 2
                    nullable: true
        network:
          title: "Network"
          description: "Network settings associated with this node."
          type: object
          nullable: true
          required:
          - interfaces
          properties:
            interfaces:
              title: "Interfaces"
              description: 'Network interfaces, in the order the guest sees them.'
              type: array
              nullable: true
              items:
                type: object
                oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/static_iface'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/dhcp_iface'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/serial_iface'
            routes:
              title: "Routes"
              description: 'Static routes phenix configures in the guest.'
              type: array
              nullable: true
              items:
                type: object
                required:
                - destination
                - next
                properties:
                  destination:
                    title: "Destination"
                    description: 'Network to reach, in CIDR notation such as 192.168.0.0/24.'
                    type: string
                    example: 192.168.0.0/24
                  next:
                    title: "Next"
                    description: 'Address of the next hop toward the destination.'
                    type: string
                    example: 192.168.1.254
                  cost:
                    title: "Cost"
                    description: 'Route cost, set as the administrative distance on Vyatta and VyOS routers.'
                    type: integer
                    default: 1
                    example: 1
                    nullable: true
            ospf:
              title: "OSPF"
              description: "Open Shortest Path First routing settings."
              type: object
              nullable: true
              required:
              - router_id
              - areas
              properties:
                router_id:
                  title: "Router Id"
                  description: 'OSPF router ID, written like an IPv4 address, such as 0.0.0.1.'
                  type: string
                  example: 0.0.0.1
                areas:
                  title: "Areas"
                  description: 'OSPF areas the router takes part in.'
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required:
                    - area_id
                    - area_networks
                    properties:
                      area_id:
                        title: "Area Id"
                        description: 'OSPF area number. 0 is the backbone area.'
                        type: integer
                        example: 1
                        default: 1
                      area_networks:
                        title: "Area Networks"
                        description: 'Networks the router advertises in the area.'
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          required:
                          - network
                          properties:
                            network:
                              title: "Network"
                              description: 'Network in CIDR notation, such as 10.1.25.0/24.'
                              type: string
                              example: 10.1.25.0/24
                dead_interval:
                  title: "Dead Interval"
                  description: >-
